description.en: Open the Explorer at Dinosauria to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开恐龙，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dinosauria time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的恐龙时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dinosauria interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的恐龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Yinlong time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的隐龙时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的恐龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

title.zh: 布氏盗龙坎德拉里亚标本窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Buriolestes holotype interval to inspect sampled occurrence context beside the documented ULBRA-PVT280 evidence.
description.zh: 在来源限定的布氏盗龙正模标本时间段附近打开地图，结合已记录的 ULBRA-PVT280 证据检查采样出现背景。

limitations: ULBRA-PVT280 and its Candelária Sequence context in Brazil are the bounded specimen-and-stratum evidence; the rounded 232.3 Ma map age is an interval selector, not a direct date on the individual.

Faunivory and placement near the sauropodomorph root are comparative character-matrix and ancestral-state reconstructions, not observations of ancestry. The bounded, non-random occurrence sample and map markers do not establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestor, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

title.zh: 曙奔龙下埃利奥特组标本窗口

description.en: Open the map within the source-bounded Lower Elliot Formation interval to inspect sampled context for the Eocursor holotype, SAM-PK-K8025.
description.zh: 在来源限定的下埃利奥特组时间段内打开地图，检查曙奔龙正模标本 SAM-PK-K8025 的采样背景。

limitations: SAM-PK-K8025 is partial material from South Africa's Lower Elliot Formation; 205.7 Ma is a rounded study-level formation window, not a direct specimen date.

Its early-ornithischian position is a morphology-matrix result rather than a preserved ancestor. Sampling and preservation are limited, and the map does not establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact specimen locality.

title.zh: 腿龙查茅斯泥岩组窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Charmouth Mudstone interval to inspect sampled context for the Scelidosaurus lectotype, NHMUK R1111.
description.zh: 在来源限定的查茅斯泥岩组时间段附近打开地图，检查腿龙选模标本 NHMUK R1111 的采样背景。

limitations: NHMUK R1111 and associated osteoderms are locality-and-stratum-bounded to the Charmouth Mudstone Formation in Dorset; 192 Ma is a rounded interval, not a directly measured age for every element.

Armour association is observed where preservation survives, while keratinous covering, biology and stem-ankylosaur placement are comparative reconstructions. Sparse, non-random sampled markers do not demonstrate a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact lectotype-map co-location.

title.zh: 羽王龙义县组皮肤衍生物窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Yixian Formation interval to inspect sampled context for the three documented Yutyrannus integument-bearing specimens.
description.zh: 在来源限定的义县组时间段附近打开地图，检查三件已记录具皮肤衍生物羽王龙标本的采样背景。

limitations: ZCDM V5000, ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001 are a three-specimen sample from the Yixian Formation, Liaoning; the 125 Ma route is a rounded formation interval rather than a direct date for each skeleton.

Associated filamentous integument is the specimen evidence, but insulation, display, whole-body coverage and phylogenetic implications are functional or comparative reconstructions. The bounded, non-random sample cannot establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact specimen-marker co-location.
